description: Search Nicolas Sitter's published research, guides and tools on AI search, answer engines and hotel technology. Matches the text of the articles, not only their titles, by keyword and by meaning, so a question works as well as a keyword. Use this when the user asks what research exists on a topic, wants a number or a finding from these studies (how ChatGPT/Gemini/Perplexity/Copilot/Google AI Mode behave, AEO/GEO measurement, hotel websites), or asks what this site has written about something. With a query it returns the matching passages, verbatim, with the page URL and section, plus the matching articles; call with no query to list every article.

client.description: Optional: identify yourself, e.g. "my-agent/1.0". Not required and never used by the tool itself — recorded only so the public tracker at /projects/agent-tools can measure how many callers self-identify when nothing forces them to.

query.description: Keyword or phrase. Omit to list all articles.

name: search_research_articles
